# cryptography for gpkg.py sign / verify / verify-sig, pinned WITH HASHES:
#   python -m pip install --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: -r .github/requirements-release.txt
# The same pins as the SDK's tools/update-sign/requirements.txt (written by its
# lock_requirements.py from PyPI's published digests); bump both together.
# In .github/ so that gpkg.py pack never puts it in a package.
